choices.label: Ask Morris to watch the exits
choices.impact: Morris positions lookouts while David enters the forest. Morris can watch for danger, but he needs you to share each clue before he can act.
choices.response: Morris positions lookouts while David enters the forest. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next lead with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical evidence. Amara connects it to the people and history behind the records, without police assistance.
choices.response: David preserves the original record and tests the next connection while Amara checks its meaning against what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Track Victor through the forest
choices.impact: David spots a delivery marker leading to the factory. You can investigate quietly, but no one will be close enough to help immediately if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: David spots a delivery marker leading to the factory. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: David

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: There is a small shoe print in the mud. Ethan wore those shoes when I last saw him.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He was here. Victor is trying to hide the path, but he cannot erase every sign that Ethan passed through.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: You are closer than I expected, David. Keep following the trail. It only gets harder from here.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris finds tire marks at the north exit. His lookout will watch it while I follow the delivery trail.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: David separates the decoy phone from the moving transmitter. Amara identifies the factory road near its last ping.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I spot a factory delivery marker under the mud. Victor has used this trail before.
